narrative: Chat message from a local delivery agent requesting address confirmation.

message.body: Hello, we have a parcel for your address but street number is unclear. Confirm address on courier-tracking-portal.com or reply here.

evidence.label: E-Commerce App Orders Page
evidence.value: App shows an item out for delivery today, but courier partner name is unlisted.

consequence_text.safe: You cross-referenced your e-commerce order page before providing address updates.
consequence_text.unsafe: Responding blindly to delivery queries can leak home address details to unauthorized entities.

teaching_point: Verify parcel tracking against your main shopping account before sharing details.
